rules: Adapters must report only capabilities actually available through the configured external provider and authorized account.
Unsupported provider-dependent actions fail closed and must not be simulated as successful.
Provider transport must require the relevant trusted account capability before execution; browser feature gating is not sufficient authorization.
GoreeCloud-native client features may operate independently when they do not require provider authority.
Self-hosted GoreeCloud Mail refers to the application and trusted backend, not Internet mailbox hosting.
